# Nintendo 3DS SDK snapshots

These source snapshots support study and source-level integration. Install the
official devkitPro toolchain and libraries for builds; the snapshots do not
replace the installed SDK packages.

| Component | Upstream | Revision | Path | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| libctru | <https://github.com/devkitPro/libctru> | `36fe1ada5b7ebe53ba4decda36d764a55f8fefb6` | `libctru/` | Upstream notice in README and source headers |
| citro3d | <https://github.com/devkitPro/citro3d> | `9f21cf7b380ce6f9e01a0420f19f0763e5443ca7` | `citro3d/` | `LICENSE` |
| citro2d | <https://github.com/devkitPro/citro2d> | `147b02aae021da61b1f620446ad2892ecc45411e` | `citro2d/` | `LICENSE` |

The devkitPro `3ds-examples` tree is linked as reference material and is not
vendored. The BlocksDS discovery index is <https://codeberg.org/blocksds/awesome-blocksds>.
